entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Provide stable mechanism for discovering `nethost` #51860
  • dotnet watch run --no-hot-reload suppresses stdout output #51856
  • `--tool-manifest` and `--create-manifest-if-needed` do not work together on `dotnet tool install` #51853
  • HttpClient BUG: Duplicate filename in Content Disposition when uploading files #51852
  • [NETSDKE2E] Sdk-manifests packages version should not be 10.0.100-rc.2 when installing .NET 10.0.101 SDK #51850
  • Scripted installs of .NET 10 SDK using dotnet-install.ps1 for x64 no longer include other platforms of the Microsoft.NETCore.App.Host packs #51840

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0.2xx] [dotnet-cli] prompt for target framework using `Spectre.Console` #51859
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51858
  • [dotnet test][MTP] Avoid surfacing `MissingTestSessionEnd` when the exit code is already non-success #51857
  • Add missing metadata for haiku-x64 #51855
  • Handle empty string returned from `Environment.GetFolderPath` #51854
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51851
  • Update R2R targets and tasks for Mach-O format support #51848
    Area-ReadyToRun
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51847
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Reduce noise from CA1873 (#51818) #51839
    Servicing-consider
  • CA1708: Ignore 'extension' blocks for naming check. #51838
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Update to the RTM build of runtime. #51660
  • [dotnet-cli] prompt for target framework using `Spectre.Console` #51509
    Area-CLI, Area-Run
  • Template Engine CLI commands: separate definitions from implementations #51747
  • Hot Reload: Do not add empty div when diagnostics are empty (1xx) #51837
    Servicing-approved, Area-Watch, 10.0.1xx
  • Update implicit versions for the November release #51652
  • Hot Reload: Do not add empty div when diagnostics are empty #51836
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51849
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51824

Updated

  • Add telemetry logger support for API-based MSBuild usage with BannedApiAnalyzer protection #51068
  • Add Microsoft.DotNet.ProjectTools project #51788
  • Skip obj→bin copy on build failure in CSharpCompilerCommand #51614
    Area-run-file
  • Add Executable launch profile support to dotnet run and dotnet watch #51727
    Partner request, Document for new feature, Area-Run, 10.0.2xx
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2844729 #51419
  • Fix working directory of simple file-based apps #51828
    Area-run-file
  • Fix CS2002 when EnableDefaultCompileItems=true in file-based apps #51790
    Area-run-file
  • Rename dnup to dotnetup #51808
  • Add support for IfDifferent #51826
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Fix concurrent tool installation race conditions with named mutex #51834
  • Fix CS0006 errors when NuGet cache cleared during file-based app recompilation #51609
    Area-run-file
  • WIP: WASM redesign #49021
    Area-AspNetCore
